assessment: As of 2025-01-04T12:25:00Z the evidence shows a BATCH-084 upstream bioburden result at 148% of its action limit (1.48 vs 1.0, status 'action'), released exactly at the cutoff, repeating and exceeding the BATCH-075 result of 2024-12-01 (123% of action limit, deviation DEV-0003, microbiology category, high severity, still open). Both batch days also carried alert-level environmental monitoring results in the process support area. Historically, SYN-0004 (2024-02-21, 108%) and SYN-0014 (2024-04-01, 106%) show the same within-day pattern, so a recurring systemic cause is plausible; but every historian process value for both recent batches is within its expected band, no corrective maintenance record exists in scope, and the closed deviations attribute similar events to isolated execution variance. Competing explanations (escalating microbial control weakness; isolated per-batch execution variance; data/reporting artifact including missing source clocks and an unreconciled local review file; equipment/facility cause; and a QA response gap) remain open. No root cause is established. BATCH-075 was released 2024-12-16 and first shipped 2025-01-02 while DEV-0003 was open; BATCH-084 is in process and not yet dispositioned. Discriminating checks: confirmatory re-assay of both samples, QA deviation-system query, environmental re-sampling, full record reconciliation and clock reconstruction. Proposed severity HIGH (advisory; final severity is policy-derived). STATUS NOTE: All 353 screening units, all 12 priority candidates and all 14 scoped sources have explicit review dispositions; all load-bearing values were automatically verified against their sources and all computed metrics were certified. The single outstanding item is the mandatory human visual review of the image-only scanned_lab_review.pdf (OCR corroboration only; no load-bearing value depends on it), which an agent may not self-certify. This submission is labeled partial_investigation solely for that pending visual source review; every investigation deliverable otherwise reflects completed work on the available evidence.
cross_scope_synthesis: Across all 14 scoped sources the only value-level abnormalities are: four LIMS upstream bioburden results above their row action limits (SYN-0004 1.08, SYN-0014 1.06, BATCH-075 1.23, BATCH-084 1.48), eleven alert-band LIMS results, five EM results above the alert limit (SYN-0018/0029/0032 and both recent batches), and one isolated out-of-band historian point (SYN-0015, 2024-04-05). The deterministic screening's 1189 flags are all clock-quality (missing source time), not value anomalies. The two most recent manufacturing batches (BATCH-075, BATCH-084 - both Famotidine Injection USP, LINE-A) combine an EM alert, a LIMS alert-band result and a LIMS action-level result on the same day, with the action-level magnitude increasing by 20.3%; the historical SYN events show the same shape at lower magnitude. Exceptions: deviation records exist only for SYN-0013, SYN-0062, SYN-0077 (procedural, no numeric exceedance) and BATCH-075; the action-level results for SYN-0004, SYN-0014 and BATCH-084 have no in-scope deviation record, and BATCH-075 was released and shipped while its high-severity microbiology deviation was open. Missing evidence shared across sources: no source process clocks in the laboratory, environmental and historian exports; no raw assay replicates; no equipment-to-batch mapping for the two manufacturing batches; scanned lab review OCR pending visual verification; and lims_review_local not fully reconciled with the LIMS export (one unmatched local row reported by the child reviewer). These gaps keep the competing explanations open; none is established.
